label: Déclaration de situation patrimoniale et déclaration d'intérêts as Minister-Delegate for Rurality
amount: Not aggregated publicly; principal declared assets are inherited agricultural and forest land in the Vosges (department 88)
detail: As a member of the Lecornu government, Fournier filed declarations of assets and interests with the Haute Autorité pour la transparence de la vie publique (HATVP); the HATVP published the declarations of 30 government members of which he was one. His patrimonial declaration lists agricultural and forest parcels in the Vosges held since 1986 by inheritance, including one farmland parcel of about 4.6 hectares valued at roughly 12,810 EUR plus several small parcels valued at modest amounts (e.g. 120, 150, 90 EUR). His interests declaration records elected mandates and unpaid (volunteer) functions, notably the presidency of the AMRF. A consolidated total net worth figure is not provided here.
